message.content:
Using integration by parts:

Let \(u = \log(x)\) and \(dv = dx\). Then \(du = (1/x)dx\) and \(v = x\).

\[
\int \log(x) dx = x*\log(x) - \int x*(1/x) dx
\]

\[
= x*\log(x) - \int 1 dx
\]

\[
= x*\log(x) - x + C
\]

<answer>x*log(x) - x + C</answer>
